page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.m1.medium is an x86_64 architecture virtual machine instance within the ecs.m1 server family. It is provisioned with 4 dedicated vCPUs and 16.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. The instance operates on the KVM hypervisor.

This instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. There are no integrated GPUs. Additionally, the underlying CPU lacks support for advanced instruction sets, including Advanced Vector Extensions (AVX, AVX-512), Advanced Matrix Extensions (AMX), and hardware-accelerated cryptography flags such as AES and SHA_NI. It also lacks hyper-threading and virtualization extensions in its flag configuration.

Given the dedicated CPU allocation and balanced 1:4 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.m1.medium offers a standard resource density profile for general-purpose workloads. The absence of local storage and advanced CPU instruction sets represents a tradeoff that positions this instance for basic utility tasks, light web serving, or development environments that do not require specialized vector processing, heavy cryptographic operations, or local high-speed disk I/O.
